text: The Bidder shall have at least one reference project with a value of at least EUR 300,000.
The Bidder shall have at least three (3) comparable reference projects within the last five years.
The Bidder shall have at least one reference project with a value of at least EUR 500,000.
The Bidder shall employ at least 20 HVAC (LVI) professionals in its own workforce.
The Bidder shall hold a valid public liability insurance with cover of at least EUR 1,000,000.
The Bidder shall hold a valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate at the time the tender is submitted.
The Bidder shall have at least one reference project with a contract value of at least EUR 2,000,000 within the last five years.
Regulatory compliance of lift maintenance -- the tenderer shall describe how statutory lift inspection and maintenance obligations will be met and documented.
Access control and security at the Buyer's premises -- the tenderer shall describe how site-access and security procedures will be observed in school and public-facing buildings.
Reporting practice to the Buyer -- the tenderer shall describe how maintenance activity and outstanding items will be reported to the city's facilities contact.
Building automation system compatibility (BACnet/Modbus) -- the tenderer shall confirm compatibility with the city's existing building automation protocols.
Training of the Buyer's property staff -- the tenderer shall describe training it will provide to the city's own property staff on maintained systems.
Method statement for installation works -- the tenderer shall provide a method statement for installation and replacement work in occupied buildings, including school premises during term time.
Quality control and testing procedures -- the tenderer shall describe its internal quality control and testing procedures for completed work.
Service level targets (SLA) -- the tenderer shall propose service level targets for response and resolution times by fault category.
Fire protection system maintenance -- the tenderer shall describe its approach to scheduled testing and maintenance of fire protection systems.
Waste management and sorting of waste on site -- the tenderer shall describe how waste generated during maintenance work will be managed and sorted in accordance with the city's waste requirements.
Warranty period for installed equipment -- the tenderer shall state the warranty period offered on equipment and materials installed.
Response time for fault situations and on-call arrangement -- the tenderer shall state its proposed response time by severity category and describe out-of-hours cover.
Condition-monitoring data collection -- the tenderer shall describe how condition-monitoring data will be collected and reported.
Content of the HVAC system maintenance agreement -- the tenderer shall describe the scope and frequency of scheduled HVAC maintenance proposed.
Environmental management during works -- the tenderer shall describe how environmental impacts will be managed during maintenance and repair work.
Pricing structure (fixed price / unit price / time-based charging) -- the tenderer shall set out its proposed pricing structure.
Contractual penalty for shortfall in service level -- the tenderer shall describe its position on a contractual penalty applying where agreed service levels are not met.
Pricing currency -- all prices shall be quoted in euro.
Invoicing frequency and format -- the tenderer shall state its proposed invoicing frequency and confirm electronic invoicing capability.
Bonus-malus scheme -- the tenderer shall describe the bonus-malus arrangement it proposes for over- and under-performance against agreed service levels.
Transparency of subcontractor costs -- where subcontractors are used, the tenderer shall describe how their costs will be made transparent to the Buyer on request.
Discount structure for framework agreement volume -- the tenderer shall propose a discount structure applicable as call-off volumes increase.
Description of the quality system.
Description of the environmental management system.
Power of attorney for the person signing the tender on the tenderer's behalf, where that person is not a registered signatory.
Tender form (Liite 1) -- the Buyer's standard tender form, to be completed and enclosed.
The tender shall be submitted as a single PDF file, without password protection.
All prices shall be quoted excluding VAT, in euro.
The minimum font size used in the tender document shall be 11 pt.
All monetary figures shall be rounded to two decimal places.
All framework agreement pricing shall be expressed in euro as the reference currency.
Content and scheduling of maintenance visits -- the tenderer shall state the proposed content and frequency of scheduled maintenance visits for each property category.
Commissioning and testing procedure -- the tenderer shall describe the commissioning and testing procedure following equipment replacement.
Spare parts availability and delivery time -- the tenderer shall state typical lead times for common spare parts and its approach for discontinued equipment.
Escalation procedure for unresolved faults -- the tenderer shall describe the escalation path used when a reported fault is not resolved within the agreed response time.
Periodic inspection of electrical installations -- the tenderer shall describe its programme for statutory periodic inspection of electrical installations across the properties.
Qualification requirements for personnel on site -- the tenderer shall list the trade qualifications and site-access clearances its personnel will hold when working in school and public buildings.
Occupational safety plan -- the tenderer shall submit an occupational safety plan covering work in and around occupied school and public buildings.
Maintenance visits to school buildings during term time shall be scheduled, where practicable, outside teaching hours.
Contract period and extension options -- the tenderer shall confirm its acceptance of the framework period and extension option stated in Section 2 of the main body.

Price indexation clause -- the tenderer shall state the index it proposes to use for annual price adjustment during the framework period, and the reference month against which adjustments would be calculated.
Prices submitted shall remain valid for 120 days from the closing date stated in Section 9 of the main body.
The tender document, excluding this annex and the other annexes, shall not exceed 20 pages.
Certificate of tax payment.
Confidentiality undertaking, signed by an authorised representative of the tenderer.
Insurance certificate, evidencing the cover stated in Section 3.
